Position: Restaurant Manager
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 p.a plus Super
Employer Name: The Savoury Dining Penrith Pty Ltd
A.B.N. 23 641 017 674
Job Location: 407-411 High St, Penrith, NSW, 2750,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 7 days - 22 Jul 2026 > 29 Jul 2026

Please include Reference: J1705-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Savoury Dining Penrith is a vibrant Southeast Asian restaurant bringing the flavours of street food to Western Sydney through an All You Can Eat dining experience. The restaurant celebrates dishes such as pho, banh xeo, laksa, Pad Thai and green curry, refined by dedicated chefs to create a generous and memorable dining experience. Designed for families, groups and food lovers, Savoury Dining offers buffet dining, à la carte, takeaway, function and catering options. With authentic flavours, friendly service and a relaxed atmosphere, it gives locals an easy way to explore the best of Southeast Asia in one place.

Website: www.thesavourydining.com.au 

About The Position
The Savoury Dining Penrith Pty Ltd is looking for a Restaurant Manager with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience and a relevant diploma.  This role reports to the Director.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Welcome and assist patrons upon arrival, provide them with menus, and take their food and beverage orders. 
- Facilitate easy reservation processes by phone or in person.
- Collaborate with the head chef on planning menus. Identify emerging trends and opportunities, innovate new dishes, and ensure accurate pricing on menus to optimise profitability. 
- Monitor inventory levels, place orders for ingredients, beverages, and supplies, and maintain adequate stock to meet customer demand. 
- Review invoices and track expenses for efficient financial management.
- Maintain consistency in service standards by implementing standard operating procedures and conducting regular training and quality checks. 
- Organise and oversee functions and events such as private parties and corporate gatherings.
- Handle financial transactions, including managing the cash register, processing payments, and reconciling daily transactions.
- Ensure cleanliness and safety standards are upheld, adhering to health and safety regulations. Develop cleaning schedules and address maintenance issues promptly.
- Collaborate with corporate clients to tailor menus for events and coordinate with staff to ensure seamless execution.
- Focus on achieving high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. 
- Implement roster structures to optimise labour costs.
- Recruit, train, and supervise front and back-of-house managers and supervisors, including performance evaluations and ongoing support.
- Develop and implement business strategies to achieve sales targets, monitor financial performance, control costs, and maximise overall profitability of the restaurant.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- A relevant diploma.
- A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
- Demonstrated genuine passion for the hospitality sector and restaurant management.
- Strong verbal communication skills, enabling effective liaison with staff, customers, and suppliers.
- Excellent organisational abilities to oversee key restaurant operations, including staff scheduling, inventory control, and financial budgeting.
- Outstanding interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire team members while maintaining a positive and collaborative work environment.
- Superior time management skills to ensure efficient daily operations and consistent, timely service delivery.
- Proven multitasking capabilities to successfully manage multiple responsibilities at once, including team supervision, customer service, and administrative tasks.
- Proactive attitude toward adopting new technologies, emerging industry trends, and modern management practices to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
- Strong capability to effectively oversee all areas of restaurant operations, including front-of-house, back-of-house, and administrative functions.

Please include Reference: J1705-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

The Client
Melbourne Earthescapes Pty Ltd is a family-owned earthmoving, landscaping, and construction business based in Ravenhall, VIC, delivering landscaping, retaining wall construction, rockwork, stone installation, and transportation services across Melbourne and surrounding regions. 

They are seeking an experienced Stonemason to join their team in Ravenhall, VIC.

The Role
The Stonemason is responsible for constructing, repairing, and installing stone structures, retaining walls, masonry features, and related stonework in accordance with project specifications and construction requirements.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Cut and shape hard and soft stone blocks and masonry slabs to construct and renovate stone structures, kitchen benchtops, and monumental masonry
•	Lay pre-cut stones and masonry blocks in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches, and structural stone features
•	Study plans and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and installation procedures
•	Erect and dismantle restricted height scaffolding in accordance with workplace safety procedures
•	Seal foundations with damp-resistant materials and apply mortar layers to support masonry installation works
•	Lay stones in rows, designs, and patterns while maintaining structural alignment and finish quality
•	Embed stone blocks in mortar and remove excess material to achieve clean and accurate finishes
•	Check vertical and horizontal alignment of stone structures using levelling and measuring equipment
•	Cut, shape, polish, and finish stone materials using hand tools, polishing equipment, and masonry machinery
•	Repair and maintain stone, brick, and masonry structures in accordance with construction requirements
•	Design, cut, and install monumental masonry and stone lettering works
•	Construct retaining walls, stone facades, and structural masonry installations for residential and commercial projects Choose and prepare appropriate metal materials for fabrication

The Requirements
•	Certificate III in Stonemasonry, Bricklaying, Construction, or equivalent trade qualification
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Stonemason within construction, landscaping, or masonry environments
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and construction measurements for masonry works
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing retaining walls, stone structures, and masonry installations across residential or commercial projects
•	At least 5 years’ experience operating masonry tools, polishing equipment, cutting machinery, and stone fabrication tools
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing stone retaining walls, rock walls, garden walls, paving, steps and outdoor stone features
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience using stone cutting, grinding, drilling, shaping and finishing tools in a construction or landscaping environment
•	Strong knowledge of masonry construction methods, mortar application, and stone finishing techniques
•	Ability to read and interpret technical plans, site measurements, and installation specifications accurately
•	Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, scaffolding requirements, and construction compliance standards
•	White Card required
•	Excavator and Skid Steer licences preferred
•	Ability to work outdoors, at heights, and across varying construction site environments
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and ability to work independently or within construction teams
•	High attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality

About Us

Victory Auto World is a premier automotive dealership dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and top-tier vehicles to our community. To support our ongoing growth and ensure the seamless execution of our daily dealership operations, we are seeking a highly organised and proactive full-time Office Manager to join our leadership team.

Position Overview

As the Office Manager at Victory Auto World, you will be responsible for orchestrating, organising, and controlling the complete functions, administrative infrastructure, and personnel resources of our dealership’s administrative office. You will work closely with dealership executives, department heads (Sales, Service, and Parts), and administrative staff to ensure maximum efficiency, absolute regulatory compliance, and a smooth workflow across the business.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Contribute to the strategic planning and operational review of dealership administrative services; establish daily office priorities, and set rigorous performance and service standards for clerical operations.
- Manage and allocate human resources, workspace, and physical office equipment to ensure the administrative department supports the fast-paced sales and service environments.
- Assign daily workloads to clerical and administrative staff, actively monitor work performance, and coordinate core personnel activities including hiring, training, performance management, and payroll processing.
- Systematically manage the office's data systems, accounts, and dealership records, ensuring accurate tracking of administrative overheads and internal documentation.
- Liaise closely with qualified professionals (including corporate accountants, legal advisors, and Ford brand representatives) to coordinate broader dealership business and facilitate swift resolution of operational problems.
- Ensure all office equipment, digital operating networks, and physical administrative spaces are meticulously maintained and stocked.
- Ensure all workplace practices strictly comply with relevant Australian government legislation, privacy policies, corporate procedures, and automotive industry protocols.
- Oversee and enforce full compliance with occupational health and safety (WHS/OH&S) regulations within the administration facilities to guarantee a safe working environment.

Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Required:
- An Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) Diploma or higher qualification in Business Administration, Management, or a closely related field, or an equivalent overseas qualification.
- Alternatively, where no formal qualification is held, at least three (3) years of relevant professional experience may substitute for the qualification, consistent with the ANZSCO Skill Level requirements.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage office personnel and liaise effectively with external professionals.

A salary of $80,000 - $95,000 per annum (plus superannuation) will be offered to the successful candidate.

The Administration Manager provides leadership and coordination of administrative services across the Rural and Remote Mental Health Service, and Barossa Hills Fleurieu Community Mental Health Team (CMHTs), ensuring the delivery of efficient, high-quality day-to-day operations including workforce planning, rostering, recruitment and performance management. The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Parkside, South Australia is a well-located inner-southern suburb just minutes from Adelaide's CBD, known for its leafy streets, convenient transport options, and easy access to local caf s, parks, and everyday amenities.

How do you build effective working relationships and communicate with a wide range of stakeholders across an organisation?

Lead and coordinate the delivery of administrative services across mental health programs

Support governance through reporting, committee coordination and business operations 

Contribute to planning, budgeting, quality improvement and project activities

result.description:
York Hospitality Pty Ltd trading as The Imperial Homestead is looking for a chef to join our team. 

This position is required on a full-time and permanent basis (38 hours per week). The successful candidate will use strong organisational and food preparation skills to supervise and coordinate staff and activities in the kitchen.

You will be expected to carry out the following duties:

•	Organise the food menus in conjunction with Management, advise on season menu changes.
•	Participate In food preparation, produce food of consistently high quality, taste and presentation and expedite during peak meal periods as needed.
•	Oversee apprentices and their training schedule.
•	Assist in instruction and training junior kitchen staff on procedures including preparation, cooking, presentation of food and standards and regulations.
•	Monitor preparation of dishes and ensure dishes are to a high quality and property presented.
•	Advise on cooking procedures with traditional dishes.
•	Operate kitchen equipment and cook various speciality dishes.
•	Monitor and maintain stock levels to reduce wastage.
•	Ensure correct storage and preservation of food where required.
•	Check the quantity and quality of received supplies to ensure goods are as ordered and quality standard met.
•	Estimate cost involved with preparation of meals.
•	Order food and other supplies as required according to budget.
•	Liaise with Restaurant manager and Directors regarding menu items, order requirements, status of equipment, work areas and general supplies to assist with established health and safety standards.
•	Inspect equipment, work areas and general supplies to ensure conformance to established health and safety standards.
•	Bring any kitchen issues to the attention of the management as necessary.
•	Beware of and enforce hygiene and health and safety requirements.
•	Cater for functions as required.

To be eligible for the position the following qualifications are necessary:

•	AQF relevant Certificate IV and at least 1 year’s relevant work experience; or
•	At least 3 years work experience in a Chef role.

Please apply with your CV/Resume if you have the relevant skills. qualifications and experience for this position

About the role
Westpoint Auto Body has been providing motor vehicle body repair and paintwork to all makes and models for a number of years. With a reputation built on quality and a team of professional body repairers at our Truganina workshop, we are now looking for an experienced Mechanic to join us. This is a hands-on trade role for someone who takes pride in their workmanship and is committed to delivering high-quality results on every job.

Key responsibilities
- Work across a steady mix of servicing and repair jobs, managing your own time and keeping jobs moving without sacrificing the standard of work
- Diagnose problems properly, using both hands-on knowledge and electronic diagnostic equipment to find the actual fault before touching anything
- Carry out repairs and mechanical rebuilds accurately, using manufacturer documentation as the benchmark and verifying your work before anything goes back to the customer
- Handle routine maintenance with the same attention as the bigger jobs, because preventative work done well keeps customers off the lift longer
- Assess vehicles for roadworthiness and prepare accurate reports or certificates where your qualifications allow

About you
- Trade-qualified mechanic (or with relevant experience) with genuine workshop experience and the diagnostic ability to back it up
- Someone who takes pride in their work and doesn't cut corners when rebuilding or reassembling
- Comfortable with computerised diagnostic tools and able to interpret what they're telling you
- Organised and self-directed, able to move between jobs without losing focus on quality
- Current driver's licence essential
